Synopsis:
British far-right commentator Milo Yiannopoulos was deported to the UK after overstaying his visa since May 2019. He was arrested at New Orleans airport by ICE, having missed an immigration hearing and received a final removal order in July 2025. Notable for the irony that Yiannopoulos himself was a vocal advocate for aggressive US deportation policies.
